name: Keys and easing
description: Keys/Keys.swift: Keyframe and Easing as FlareCore's types under kernel names, Track (one property or all), KeyRef, KeyState (not animated, animated, keyed here), Segment, EasePreset (the one preset list with its easing and title), EaseCurve (Bezier handles, moving a handle, samples capped at 4096) and RemovePolicy. Keys/KeyRules.swift: KeyRules (key state, toggle a key or the animation, move keys all or nothing in a range, remove by policy, insert and remove frames) and KeyRefusal. Stubs from EK-3; bodies EK-15 and EK-16. Keys/FrameRate.swift: FrameRate (an exact rational rate, the common list of nine, whole and drop-frame, nominal, seconds and frames by one rounding rule, decoding {num, den}, a legacy Int or a decimal from the list). Keys/Timecode.swift: Timecode (HH:MM:SS:FF, drop-frame HH:MM:SS;FF at 29.97 and 59.94, and back). Keys/TimeCommands.swift: the time.rates and time.timecode query specs. Stubs from FR-1; bodies FR-3.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
